notes: Read SKILL.md in full (the only file). The skill covers CDN configuration: CloudFront distributions via CLI and Terraform, invalidations, CloudFront Functions, Cloudflare zone setup, cache rules and purges via the Cloudflare API, origin nginx cache headers, cache warming and cache-hit monitoring.

Medium: following it has the agent call live services with the user's credentials: AWS CLI to create a distribution and invalidations, and curl to the Cloudflare v4 API with `Authorization: Bearer $CF_API_TOKEN` to add a zone, set cache rules and purge cache, including `purge_everything` (SKILL.md:238-241). Acceptable because these act on the user's own CDN for the task they asked for; purging only causes cache misses, the token is read from an environment variable and sent only to api.cloudflare.com, and there are no delete or security-disabling steps.

Users should confirm full purges and `/*` invalidations, which can raise origin load and cost (the skill itself warns at SKILL.md:93, 351). Related Skills (SKILL.md:355-358) link to sibling skills ../dns-management/, ../reverse-proxy/, ../load-balancing/ and ../../cloudflare/cloudflare-pages/ as optional reading only.
